messages:
prod_incident_bot: ALERT: Canary cohort for rollout v3.12 (encoder-refactor) in eu-west-1 - 5xx rate = 8% over last 3m, latency p95 up 2.4x. Trigger: canary-error-slo. link: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123
oncall-alex: acked. paging @sre_maria and @derek_prod. jumping in.
sre_maria: on it. can anyone confirm which feature flags were toggled for this rollout?
derek_prod: rollout uses `rollout_new_encoder` and traffic split via router-service. I see canary at 25% for ~12m and error spike aligns w/ canary start. grafana: https://grafana.internal/d/abc123?view=canary
jamie_release: confirmed flag `rollout_new_encoder` enabled in eu-west for canary. we expected graceful fallback but logs show NPE in encoder path on some payload shapes.
customer-ops: FYI support has 4 tickets reporting 502s from EU customers in last 10m, all low-medium tier. no major accounts flagged yet.
prod_incident_bot: AUTOMATION: auto-rollback DID NOT TRIGGER - metric filter mis-configured (`5xx_rate_canary` pattern missed). Logged as automation-failure-307.
sre_maria: ok plan: 1) flip flag off (kill-switch) 2) drain canary hosts from LB 3) if errors persist, do manual deployment rollback `kubectl rollout undo` 4) verify smoke tests + 5xx < 0.5% for 5m. agree?
jamie_release: agree. I can flip flag now.
jamie_release: ```bash
# flip feature flag (internal API)
curl -s -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"flag":"rollout_new_encoder","value":false}'
```
jamie_release: done. response: {"status":"ok","flag":"rollout_new_encoder","value":false} :white_check_mark:
prod_incident_bot: ACTION: flag-change detected by router. starting 60s stabilization window.
sre_maria: starting drain for canary pool eu-west-canary-1 via router svc: `routerctl drain --pool eu-west-canary-1 --grace 30s`
derek_prod: running drain now. logs show TCP connections draining.
derek_prod: after flag flip + drain: 5xx rate dropped 8% -> 0.9% in 90s. p95 latency trending down.
sre_maria: running smoke test suite against canary endpoints (quick checks)
sre_maria: smoke OK for 3/3 endpoints. error counts ~ baseline.
customer-ops: informing support: impact reduced, continue monitoring.
jamie_release: note: automation rollback didn't fire because alert metric name mismatch. will open follow-up to fix metric mapping.
prod_incident_bot: MONITOR: 5m rolling 5xx = 0.4%, p95 within expected.
sre_maria: since flag flip resolved errors, we will not perform full `kubectl rollout undo` to avoid churn. leaving canary drained and paused. will hold off further rollout until postmortem.
derek_prod: -> created temporary tag on router to pin stable model for eu-west.
oncall-alex: great work. assign postmortem to @jamie_release + @sre_maria, please include automation gap and steps to add a kill-switch runbook.
jamie_release: will do, exporting logs and commands used. I'll include exact flag API payload and `routerctl` commands.
prod_incident_bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: root cause = bad encoder edge case in canary variant + automation metric mismatch. mitigation = feature-flag kill-switch + canary drain. no major customers impacted.
customer-ops: support notified, closing tickets as resolved where applicable.
oncall-alex: closing thread. please add short blameless note in #postmortems when ready. :thumbsup:
